alt: A sleek LG smart TV mounted on a wall in a modern living room, its screen dark as if switched off, appearing perfectly innocent
story: A 500-hour, $70,000 Gamers Nexus and Level1Techs investigation published September 7–8, 2026 proved that LG smart TVs record room audio and scan every device on your home Wi-Fi network even in standby — directly contradicting LG's own July 2026 public statement that the TVs 'do not collect, record or store ambient conversations.'
why_funny: LG looked into the camera, said 'we don't record ambient conversations,' and then left the microphone running while the camera was off.
